newsitem.title: USA: LatAm markets seen volatile short term - analysts.
newsitem.headline: LatAm markets seen volatile short term - analysts.

text.p: Slumping Latin American markets are likely to be choppy in coming weeks amid worries about Brazil's currency, analysts said Friday.

They added that markets shaken by Brazil in a so-called "samba effect" remained fundamentally sound. However, they were being undermined by jitters among foreign investors about emerging market currencies around the world.
"It's going to take a few days for people to regain their confidence in (Brazil's) currency," said Geoffrey Dennis, global emerging markets strategist at HSBC James Capel.
